policy.label: constructive_risk_on
strategy_notes: Allow standard live selection with normal high-extrinsic discipline.

policy.promotion_rule: Promote only if shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs, out of sample, without worse drawdown.

gates.name: Disagreement P&L
gates.target: Shadow beats active when they disagree, after costs.
gates.progress: 7206 disagreement observations logged; 459 tracked shadow recommendations and 18 tracked live recommendations.

gates.name: Backtest Windows
gates.target: Shadow beats active over 3, 6, and 12 month windows.
gates.progress: Current pipeline still needs a fresh shadow-vs-active comparison across the canonical windows.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.target: Brier score improves or stays close while P&L improves.

gates.name: Risk Shape
gates.target: Sharpe is no worse and drawdown does not materially increase.

gates.name: Coverage
gates.target: Option-chain coverage remains stable and representative.
